puzzles.title: The Locked Safe
puzzles.room_description: You're in a dimly lit server room. Cables snake across the floor. A heavy safe sits against the wall. On the wall hangs a faded chart.

safe.description: A heavy iron safe with a keypad. Binary sequences are etched into the door.
safe.examine:
Two sequences are engraved: [ 01001000 ] [ 01001001 ]
The keypad has a prompt: 'Enter the ASCII characters.'

chart.description: A faded poster on the wall.
chart.examine:
An ASCII reference chart. Useful values:
  H = 72 = 01001000
  I = 73 = 01001001
  A = 65  B = 66  C = 67 ...

keypad.description: A numeric keypad beside the safe.
keypad.examine: The keypad accepts text input. Type your answer to unlock the safe.

hints: There's an ASCII chart on the wall — try EXAMINE CHART.
Convert each group of 8 bits to a decimal number first.

puzzles.title: The Cipher Machine
puzzles.room_description: A dusty room with an old mechanical cipher machine humming on the table. A note is pinned to the wall beside it.

machine.description: An old cipher machine with a screen and a rotating dial.
machine.examine:
The screen reads: KHOOR ZRUOG
The dial is set to 3.
A label reads: 'Shift back to reveal the truth.'

note.description: A note pinned to the wall.
note.examine:
The note reads:
'Each letter has been shifted forward in the alphabet.
To decode, use: DECODE <message> <shift>'
Example: DECODE KHOOR ZRUOG 3

hints: Each letter has been moved forward in the alphabet by the number on the dial.
To decode, move each letter back by 3 positions. K becomes H, H becomes E, etc.

puzzles.title: The Combination Cabinet
puzzles.room_description: A tall cabinet sealed with three combination locks. A screen above each lock displays a sequence of numbers with the last one missing.

rounds.explanation: Powers of 2 — each number is doubled.
Fibonacci sequence — each number is the sum of the two before it.
Triangular numbers — the gap between each number increases by 1 each time.

cabinet.description: A tall cabinet with three combination locks.
cabinet.examine:
Lock 1: [LOCKED]  Lock 2: [LOCKED]  Lock 3: [LOCKED]
Each lock has a sequence of numbers displayed above it.
You must find the next number in each sequence to unlock it.

screen.description: A screen above the cabinet showing the current sequence.
screen.examine:
The screen shows a sequence of numbers ending with a question mark.
Type ENTER <number> to submit your answer.

hints: Look at the relationship between consecutive numbers in the sequence.
Are the numbers being added together, multiplied, or something else?
Round 1: try doubling the last number.

puzzles.title: The Logic Gate Lock
puzzles.room_description: You face a large, heavy door with 4 coloured switches: A,B,C and D, and a display showing a Boolean expression.

door.description: A heavy door with four switches and a display above it.
door.examine:
The display reads: (A AND B) OR (NOT C)
The light above the door is RED. [LOCKED]

switches.description: Four coloured switches labelled A, B, C and D.
switches.examine:
Each switch can be ON (1) or OFF (0).
Use FLIP <switch> to toggle a switch.
Example: FLIP A

manual.description: A laminated instruction card on the wall.
manual.examine:
Boolean logic reference:
  AND — true only if BOTH sides are true
  OR  — true if EITHER side is true
  NOT — inverts the value (0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0)

hints: Try EXAMINE MANUAL to read the logic reference card.
Work from the inside out. What makes (NOT C) true?
If C is 0, then NOT C is 1. OR only needs one side to be true — so the whole expression becomes true.

puzzles.title: The Robot Navigator
puzzles.room_description: A robot must reach the exit through a grid with obstacles.

robot.description: A small robot waiting for instructions.
